text:
Lina: Boston pop-up confirmed for Nov 14. Tabletop + 10-min demo slot. Need owners: speaker submission, demo script, swag, shipping, lead capture. Shipping cutoff Nov 6. Who can take speaker submission by EOD?

Omar: I can file the submission. Will compress the cost vs latency narrative into a 6-slide deck + a 3-min live prefix-cache demo. Any slide limit from the organizer?

ops-bot: Organizer note: 6 slides max for demo slots. Bio + slide deck due 48h prior. No live API keys on stage.

Jules: I'll own AV and onsite logistics. Need a 15" monitor, HDMI + USB-C dongles, 2 lavs, power strip, and gaffer. I can receive shipment if someone can add me to the manifest.

Lina: Great. Swag idea: 250 stickers, 120 postcards, 60 handwarmers (branded). Vendor suggestion: northshore-swag.com. PO #PO-7712. Handwarmers add cost  recommend cutting postcards to 90 to keep budget flat.

Rina: I can trim postcards to 90. Vendor ETA Nov 8 if we place order today. Tracking and hold notes to be added to the sheet.

Kai: Lead capture: QR -> short Airtable form (name, email, team, interest checkbox), raffle opt-in. Routing: Airtable webhook -> HubSpot list "Boston Pop-up" -> assign to Jules for 48h -> SDR rotation. Kai can own the Airtable + Zap.

Kai: I'll add utm params to the QR (utm_source=boston_popup&utm_campaign=nov14_demo). Also will include a tiny incentive note: "enter raffle for a handwarmer pack".

Omar: Will add utm to all demo links. Also need the latest perf charts (2-token baseline + 1k tail) for the one-pager handout. Can eng-runtime-bot upload?

eng-runtime-bot: Uploaded perf artifact: https://drive.re/redwood/bench/boston_nov14_tail.png

Jules: Shipping contact needed. I'll be onsite but want courier name + tracking to present at check-in. Also propose table layout: monitor center, postcards left, stickers top-right, handwarmers in a small crate under table.

Rina: Shipping carrier: HarborLine Express. Tracking HL55667788. I'll add hold-for-pickup note and recipient "Jules / Redwood Inference". Sheet updated: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1boston-popup-plan (shipping rows filled).

Lina: One-pager: micro-benchmark (heatmap of cost vs latency) + 3 quick integration tips (batching, prefix cache, model selection). Rina can you draft copy by Nov 2?

Rina: Yep. Drafting now. Need the small heatmap PNG and the benchmark numbers (median tail).

eng-runtime-bot: Bench numbers attached in the drive folder.

Kai: Zapier mapping draft:
```
trigger: airtable.record_created
action: POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact
payload: {"properties":[{"property":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"property":"utm_source","value":"boston_popup"},{"property":"owner","value":"Jules"}]}
```
I'll test with a sandbox entry and report results by Nov 4.

Omar: Speaker bio + headshot coming today. Also will include a short demo script and a fallback recorded clip (no keys).

Jules: Arrival checklist to me by Nov 10: bring monitor, dongles, 2x lavs, power strip, gaffer, backup USB with recorded demo, printed one-pagers (60), stickers (250), postcards (90), handwarmers (60).

Lina: Dry run Nov 12 @ 11am ET. Recap owners: Omar = speaker submission + demo script + fallback clip, Rina = one-pager + swag coordination, Kai = Airtable + Zap + QR, Jules = AV + onsite + receiving. Rina/Tia please confirm PO and invoice upload.

Rina: PO uploaded and confirmed with HarborLine. Invoice attached to event sheet. Will DM Jules tracking again.

Lina: Thanks all. Quick Zap snippet for the runbook included above. We'll follow up with the runbook doc after the dry run. :sparkles:
